survey: Moon-base card seen from one raised three-quarter view, looking down at about 25° over cratered ground. Main parts: (1) A low cylindrical drum sits flat on the ground. Its top is a wide, narrow ellipse, about as flat as the crater rims around it, so the drum and ground share one camera. (2) A glass dome sits on the drum's top ring, slightly inset. Its white ribs curve over the dome and meet at a small cap at the top, which is also seen from above. The inner ring visible through the glass is an ellipse that matches the drum top. (3) A horizontal tunnel cylinder comes out of the drum toward the front left and rests on two small block feet on the ground. It has a collar band near its middle and a rounded end cap facing front left. The end cap is a tall ellipse, which fits an axis turned partly toward the viewer, and the yellow door is fitted flat onto that cap. (4) A metal ladder leans against the front of the drum. Its top is at the drum's upper rim and its feet stand on the ground slightly in front of the drum's base, so it leans back. The rungs are evenly spaced and parallel. (5) The ground has craters and rocks whose ellipses get narrower with distance and agree with the high viewpoint. The drum base, the tunnel feet and the ladder feet all meet the ground at the angle the ground is drawn, with matching contact shadows.
